_: THE CLASSIFICATION PARITY CORPUS. One file, two readers: server/tests/wrapper_parity.rs (recall::classify_user) and web/tests/unit/chat-wrapper-parity.test.ts (classifyPrompt). Neither language errors when the two planes disagree - no match on either Kind enum is exhaustive - so this corpus is the ONLY guard. Fields: name, input (the raw user-role body), kind, label (absent = none), text, survives (does the chat renderer's calm-view filter keep it). Add a line here before adding a wrapper arm to either classifier. NOTE on provenance: the readers below TRUST the wrapper because the writers refuse to emit one - lifecycle::send_text and lifecycle::paste answer 400 on wrapper markup, agents::delegate refuses them on every delegated prompt, and scheduler::create is the funnel every schedule writer passes (bearer POST, PATCH, hook create, test-fire) so a scheduled prompt can never carry one either; wrap_schedule additionally defangs a body that predates those guards, and lifecycle::send_harness_text is the only unguarded seam (two callers, pinned by tests/archive_schedule_contract.rs). Do not weaken a writer without changing what these rows claim.
